settings.question: Do you ship Indian wear across Germany and Europe?
settings.answer: Yes! We ship all ready-to-ship collections directly from our Berlin fulfillment hub. Deliveries within Germany take 1–3 business days. We also ship across all European Union countries and Switzerland within 3–5 business days with zero customs duties.

settings.question: Can I visit your showroom in Berlin to try outfits in person?
settings.answer: Yes, absolutely! You can visit our retail store & showroom at The Playce Mall (Potsdamer Platz), Shop No. 55, Floor -1, Alte Potsdamer Str. 7, 10785 Berlin. We are open Monday to Saturday from 10:00 to 20:00.

settings.question: How does your 1-on-1 live video consultation work?
settings.answer: If you live outside Berlin, you can book a free 1-on-1 video call via WhatsApp. Our stylists show you the fabric, hand embroidery details in natural lighting, and help you take precise measurements before placing an order.

settings.question: How do I choose the correct size for Lehengas, Sarees, and Suits?
settings.answer: Every product includes an accurate sizing chart in centimetres and inches. Sarees come with unstitched or semi-stitched blouse pieces, and many lehengas have adjustable drawstring waists. You can also send us your bust, waist, and height via WhatsApp to help you choose the best fitting size.

settings.question: What is your return policy and how do I return items?
settings.answer:
We accept returns on unworn items with original tags intact within 14 days of delivery.

You have two return options:
1. In-Person Returns: You can return or exchange items in person directly at our retail boutique at The Playce (Potsdamer Platz), Shop No. 55, Floor -1, Alte Potsdamer Str. 7, 10785 Berlin.
2. Mailed / Shipped Returns: All postal return parcels must be shipped exclusively to our returns office address:

Neha Aggarwal
Dolgenseestr. 9A
10319 Berlin, Germany

Important Note: Postal package delivery to our Potsdamer Platz store is not possible; all mailed returns must be sent to Dolgenseestr. 9A.
